collections.title: Writing with Light
collections.note: Long exposures in a darkened room. The shutter stays open while students draw with handheld lights, writing directly onto the frame. Every mark is intentional, made in the dark, and seen only when the exposure ends.

collections.title: Multiples
collections.note: Portraits built from more than one exposure. Students layer a single subject across time and light in one frame, turning a portrait into a study of presence, motion, and identity.

collections.title: Product: Sauce Baby
